analysis: Perp-driven aggressive selling has pushed price just below the 77,500 Value Area Low, but relatively muted spot CVD delta suggests leverage expansion rather than spot capitulation. A failure of perp sellers to maintain acceptance below VAL heightens the risk of a mean-reverting short squeeze back toward the 77,550 POC.
key_risk: Perp short crowding below 77,500 VAL triggering a short squeeze upon spot bid absorption.
